title.narrative: Technical Assistance Grant: Transport Sector Project Development Facility

description.narrative: The proposed Transport Sector Project Development Facility (PDF) will improve the startup efficiency for priority transport projects in roads, maritime and aviation sectors for funding by assisting the government transport agencies to prepare feasibility studies, detailed designs, and supporting initial procurement and safeguards activities.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Feasibility studies and detailed designs completed for selected priority projects. Indicator: Detailed designs completed for at least two projects and feasibility studies for three projects with at least 40% women's participation during consultations. Progress/Status: The feasibility study and detailed designs for the scope of the Land and Maritime Connectivity Project were completed. The detailed design was reviewed by the contractors before their work commencement at the field.
The grant was extended in May 2024, and the consultant recruitment for preparatory works for pipeline projects (2027 and onwards) is ongoing. The expected contract award is in 2025 Q1.
